title: Basic Instep Drive
description: Learn the fundamental technique for powerful shooting with your laces.

steps.title: Approach
steps.instruction: Stand 2-3 steps behind the ball at a 30-45 degree angle.

steps.title: Plant Foot
steps.instruction: Step forward and place your non-kicking foot 6-8 inches to the side of the ball, pointing at your target.

steps.title: Backswing
steps.instruction: Swing your kicking leg back with your knee bent. Lock your ankle with your toes pointed down.

steps.title: Contact
steps.instruction: Strike the center of the ball with your laces (instep). Keep your body over the ball.

steps.title: Follow Through
steps.instruction: Follow through with your kicking leg moving upward. Land on your kicking foot.

title: Curved Shot (Inside Foot)
description: Master the art of bending the ball around obstacles.

steps.title: Approach
steps.instruction: Approach the ball from a wider angle (45-60 degrees).

steps.title: Plant Foot
steps.instruction: Place your plant foot slightly wider and further from the ball than a normal shot.

steps.title: Contact Point
steps.instruction: Strike the ball with the inside of your foot, hitting the side of the ball rather than the center.

steps.title: Swing Path
steps.instruction: Swing your leg across your body, wrapping your foot around the ball to create spin.

steps.title: Follow Through
steps.instruction: Follow through across your body, rotating your hips to generate maximum curve.

title: Knuckleball Technique
description: Learn to hit unpredictable shots with no spin.

steps.title: Approach
steps.instruction: Approach the ball straight on with a moderate run-up.

steps.title: Plant Foot
steps.instruction: Place plant foot alongside the ball, pointing directly at target.

steps.title: Contact
steps.instruction: Strike the exact center of the ball with your instep. Keep ankle extremely rigid.

steps.title: No Spin
steps.instruction: Focus on hitting through the ball without creating any rotation.

steps.title: Stunted Follow Through
steps.instruction: Stop your follow-through abruptly after contact to prevent spin.

title: First Touch Control
description: Improve your ability to control the ball instantly.

steps.title: Preparation
steps.instruction: Stand on balls of your feet, ready to move.

steps.title: Presentation
steps.instruction: Present the inside of your foot to the incoming ball.

steps.title: Cushion
steps.instruction: Withdraw your foot slightly upon contact to absorb impact.

steps.title: Direction
steps.instruction: Direct the ball into open space for your next move.

title: Weak Foot Passing
description: Develop accuracy and power with your non-dominant foot.

steps.title: Setup
steps.instruction: Find a wall or partner. Stand 5-10 meters away.

steps.title: Technique
steps.instruction: Focus on proper form: plant foot beside ball, ankle locked, follow through.

steps.title: Repetition
steps.instruction: Pass 50 times using ONLY your weak foot.

steps.title: Moving Ball
steps.instruction: Pass, receive with weak foot, then pass again. Keep ball moving.

title: Defensive Positioning
description: Learn proper body orientation and spacing for defense.

steps.title: Stance
steps.instruction: Adopt a staggered stance, knees bent, one foot forward.

steps.title: Angle
steps.instruction: Angle your body to force the attacker to one side (usually outside).

steps.title: Distance
steps.instruction: Maintain arm's length distance initially. Close down when attacker loses control.

steps.title: Patience
steps.instruction: Don't dive in. Wait for the attacker to make a mistake.

title: Creating Space
description: Learn movements to lose your marker and receive the ball.

steps.title: Check Away
steps.instruction: Move away from the ball first to push defender back.

steps.title: Check To
steps.instruction: Explode back towards the ball to create separation.

steps.title: Body Shape
steps.instruction: Arrive with body open to the field, not just facing the ball.

steps.title: Scan
steps.instruction: Check your shoulder before receiving to know your next move.

title: Volley Technique
description: Master striking the ball while it's in the air.

steps.title: Eye Contact
steps.instruction: Keep eyes locked on the ball throughout its flight.

steps.title: Body Position
steps.instruction: Adjust feet quickly to get your body in line with the ball's path.

steps.title: Balance
steps.instruction: Plant foot must be solid. Lean slightly forward to keep shot down.

steps.title: Strike
steps.instruction: Strike the ball's center with a horizontal swinging motion.

title: Chip Shot
description: Learn to lift the ball delicately over the goalkeeper.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.instruction: Check if goalkeeper is off their line or rushing out.

steps.title: Plant Foot
steps.instruction: Plant foot slightly behind the ball to get underneath it.

steps.title: Strike
steps.instruction: Stab underneath the ball with your toes. Minimal follow-through.

steps.title: Backspin
steps.instruction: Ensure ball has backspin to slow down upon landing.

title: Close Range Finishing
description: Improve your composure and accuracy inside the box.

steps.title: Composure
steps.instruction: Take a breath. Don't rush unless absolutely necessary.

steps.title: Placement
steps.instruction: Aim for corners. Low shots are harder for keepers to save.

steps.title: Side Foot
steps.instruction: Use inside of foot for accuracy over power.

steps.title: Rebounds
steps.instruction: Always follow your shot in case of a save.

steps.title: Start
steps.instruction: Drop ball from hands, kick up with laces, catch.

steps.title: One Foot
steps.instruction: Try 2-3 touches with same foot before catching.

steps.title: Alternating
steps.instruction: Right foot, left foot, catch. Keep ankles locked.

steps.title: No Hands
steps.instruction: Try to keep ball up as long as possible without using hands.

steps.title: Pass
steps.instruction: Pass firmly to teammate or wall.

steps.title: Sprint
steps.instruction: Immediately sprint past the defender into open space.

steps.title: Receive
steps.instruction: Receive the return pass in stride, without breaking momentum.

title: Header Technique
description: Learn to head the ball safely and powerfully.

steps.title: Eyes Open
steps.instruction: Watch ball all the way to your forehead. Keep eyes open.

steps.title: Contact
steps.instruction: Use center of forehead (hairline), not top of head.

steps.title: Power
steps.instruction: generate power from core and neck muscles, not just neck.

steps.title: Direction
steps.instruction: Head down for goal, high and wide for defense.

title: Dribbling - Slalom
description: Improve close control while changing direction.

steps.title: Setup
steps.instruction: Place 5-6 cones in a straight line, 1 meter apart.

steps.title: Execution
steps.instruction: Weave through cones using inside and outside of both feet.

steps.title: Control
steps.instruction: Keep ball close. Small touches are better than big ones.

steps.title: Head Up
steps.instruction: Try to glance up between touches, not staring at feet.

title: Speed & Agility
description: Enhance your physical capability for football.

steps.title: Warm Up
steps.instruction: 5 mins light jogging and dynamic stretching.

steps.title: Sprints
steps.instruction: 10x 20m sprints. Full intensity. Walk back recovery.

steps.title: Shuttles
steps.instruction: Place cones 5m, 10m, 15m apart. Run to first and back, second and back, etc.

steps.title: Ladder
steps.instruction: Quick feet drills through agility ladder or cones.
